title: 第6章 筑基异象
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
筑基异象的金光在苍梧宗上空持续了整整一炷香才渐渐消散。

    全宗都看见了。

    从外门杂役到内门长老，所有人都在议论同一个名字——林尘。

    掌门大殿里，玉玲珑站在殿中央，面前是须发皆白的掌门和几位长老。

    “玉长老，昨晚的筑基异象是怎么回事？”

    掌门开门见山。

    “你的弟子林尘，从炼气三层到筑基初期，前后不到半个月。这个速度苍梧宗建宗八百年从未有过。”

    “掌门是怀疑我弟子修炼了魔功？”

    玉玲珑语气平静。

    “如果是魔功，筑基异象应该是黑色魔气，而不是金色灵光。这一点在座的各位都清楚。”

    “我不是怀疑他修炼魔功。”

    掌门摆了摆手。

    “我是想知道，他的体质到底有什么特殊之处。一个外门弟子，三年不突破，突然在半个月内连跳六层突破筑基——这样的弟子，我这个做掌门的总要了解一下。”

    “他的体质确实特殊，属于罕见的修炼天赋。具体是什么体质，恕我不便透露。”

    玉玲珑看着掌门，语气不卑不亢。

    “但我可以以元婴期的修为担保，林尘不是魔修，也没有修炼任何旁门左道。他的突破全靠自己的天赋和努力——还有我这个师尊的教导。”

    掌门沉默了一会儿。

    大殿里的其他几位长老也都各有心思。

    丹药堂的钱长老捋着胡须，若有所思地看着玉玲珑。

    藏书阁的孙老眯着眼睛，手指在膝盖上轻轻敲着。

    只有戒律堂首座陈元面无表情地坐在角落里，一双眼睛阴沉地盯着玉玲珑的背影。

    “好，你不说我不勉强。”

    掌门终于开口。

    “但我问你另一件事——你的修为，也是因为林尘才突破元婴的吧？”

    玉玲珑没有回答。

    “你不回答我也猜得到。你困在金丹后期六年，整个苍梧宗都知道。现在你突破元婴，你的弟子半个月突破筑基——这中间要是没有关联，我这掌门就白当了。”

    掌门站起来，走到玉玲珑面前。

    “玉长老，我不管你弟子的体质是什么，也不管你们师徒之间有什么秘密。只要他还是苍梧宗的弟子，宗门就会护着他。但如果有一天他的体质引来了宗门护不住的麻烦——我希望你能提前告诉我。”

    “掌门放心。真有那一天，我会带他离开宗门，不给苍梧宗添麻烦。”

    掌门看了她半晌，最终叹了口气。

    “去吧。让你弟子低调一点，别再闹出这么大的动静了。”

    玉玲珑行了一礼，转身走出大殿。

    她刚走，陈元就站了起来。

    “掌门，林尘的体质绝非寻常。能在半个月内从炼气三层突破到筑基，而且还带着玉玲珑一起突破元婴——这种体质，恐怕不是简单的修炼天赋。”

    “陈首座想说什么？”

    掌门看着他。

    “我想说，如果林尘的体质真有这么逆天，那我们苍梧宗留不住他。”

    陈元的声音很平静，但字字诛心。

    “与其等他引来大势力抢夺，不如主动把他的情况上报给中州的正道联盟。这样一来可以换取正道联盟的庇护，二来也能让林尘得到更好的培养。”

    “上报？”

    钱长老冷笑一声。

    “陈首座是想把林尘交出去换资源吧。正道联盟那群人什么德性你不清楚？落到他们手里，林尘不被扒一层皮才怪。”

    “钱长老此言差矣。我说的是上报，不是交人。”

    陈元面不改色。

    “当然，如果掌门觉得不妥，那就当我没说。”

    “此事不必再议。”

    掌门摆了摆手。
content_en:
The golden light of the foundation building vision lasted for a whole stick of incense over Cangwu Sect before gradually dissipating.

    The whole sect saw it.

    From the outer sect servants to the inner sect elders, everyone was talking about the same name - Lin Chen.

    In the master's hall, Yu Linglong stood in the center of the hall, in front of the master with white hair and beard and several elders.

    "Elder Yu, what happened to the foundation-building phenomenon last night?"

    The leader got straight to the point.

    "Your disciple Lin Chen went from the third level of Qi Refining to the early stage of foundation building in less than half a month. This speed has never been seen in the 800 years since the Cangwu Sect was founded."

    "Does the leader suspect that my disciple has practiced magic?"

    Yu Linglong's tone was calm.

    "If it is a magic power, the foundation-building vision should be black magic energy, not golden aura. Everyone here knows this."

    "I'm not doubting that he practices magic."

    The leader waved his hand.

    "I want to know what's so special about his physique. An outer sect disciple who hasn't made a breakthrough for three years suddenly jumps six levels in half a month to break through the foundation building—such a disciple, as the leader, I always need to know about."

    "His physique is indeed special, and it is a rare cultivation talent. I forgive my inconvenience to disclose the specific physique."

    Yu Linglong looked at the leader, her tone neither humble nor arrogant.

    "But I can guarantee with my cultivation at the Nascent Soul stage that Lin Chen is not a demonic cultivator, and he has not practiced any heresy. His breakthrough is all due to his own talent and hard work - and the teachings of my master."

    The leader was silent for a while.

    Several other elders in the hall also had their own thoughts.

    Elder Qian of the Pill Hall stroked his beard and looked at Yu Linglong thoughtfully.

    Mr. Sun in the library squinted his eyes and tapped his fingers lightly on his knees.

    Only Chen Yuan, the leader of the Discipline Hall, sat in the corner expressionlessly, staring gloomily at Yu Linglong's back.

    "Okay, if you don't tell me, I won't force you."

    The leader finally spoke.

    "But let me ask you another thing - your cultivation level was also able to break through the Nascent Soul because of Lin Chen, right?"

    Yu Linglong didn't answer.

    "I can guess it even if you don't answer. You have been trapped in the late stage of Jindan for six years, and the entire Cangwu Sect knows it. Now you have broken through Nascent Soul, and your disciple has broken through Foundation Establishment in half a month. If there is no connection between them, my position as the leader will be in vain."

    The leader stood up and walked to Yu Linglong.

    "Elder Yu, I don't care what your disciple's physique is, or what secrets there are between you master and disciple. As long as he is still a disciple of Cangwu Sect, the sect will protect him. But if one day his physique causes trouble that the sect cannot protect - I hope you can tell me in advance."

    "Don't worry, Master. One day, I will take him out of the sect and not cause any trouble to Cangwu Sect."

    The leader looked at her for a long time and finally sighed.

    "Go ahead. Tell your disciple to keep a low profile and stop making such a big noise."

    Yu Linglong bowed, turned around and walked out of the hall.

    As soon as she left, Chen Yuan stood up.

    "Master, Lin Chen's physique is absolutely extraordinary. He was able to break through from the third level of Qi Refining to Foundation Establishment within half a month, and he also took Yu Linglong with him to break through to the Nascent Soul - this kind of physique is probably not a simple cultivation talent."

    "What does Mr. Chen want to say?"

    The leader looked at him.

    "I want to say that if Lin Chen's physique is really so incredible, then our Cangwu Sect will not be able to keep him."

    Chen Yuan's voice was calm, but every word was heartbreaking.

    "Instead of waiting for him to attract big forces to rob him, it is better to take the initiative to report his situation to the Righteous Alliance in Zhongzhou. In this way, we can get the protection of the Righteous Alliance, and secondly, Lin Chen can be better trained."

    "Report?"

    Elder Qian sneered.

    "Boss Chen wants to hand over Lin Chen in exchange for resources. You don't know the virtues of those people in the Righteous Alliance? It would be strange if Lin Chen didn't have his skin peeled off if he fell into their hands."

    "Elder Qian's words are wrong. What I said was reporting, not handing over."

    Chen Yuan's expression did not change.

    "Of course, if the head feels something is inappropriate, just pretend I didn't say anything."

    "This matter does not need to be discussed further."

    The leader waved his hand.
